message.nusmp.mega.mech.need_xp: The altar wants %s levels of experience.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.need_hp: You are too weak to pay in blood.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.key_taken: You take the key. Carry it to the other pedestal.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.downed: You are down! A friend must kneel beside you.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.revived: You are back on your feet.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.hint.kill_all: Its wardens hold it up: kill them all.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.hint.kill_marked: One marked warden holds it up: kill the keystone.

message.nusmp.mega.mech.hint.no_damage: Take no damage and it lets go.
message.nusmp.mega.mech.hint.pay_item: The altar wants a price in items.
